scripts.semgrep: semgrep scan --config p/typescript --config p/react --config p/secrets --config p/owasp-top-ten --config .semgrep/rules --error
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:hooks && pnpm boundaries && pnpm build --filter=app... --filter=api...
scripts.graph: mkdir -p docs/graph && depcruise apps packages --output-type mermaid --output-to docs/graph/dependencies.mmd && depcruise apps packages --output-type err-long
scripts.migrate: cd packages/database && pnpm exec prisma format && pnpm exec prisma generate && pnpm exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.migrate:deploy: cd packages/database && pnpm exec prisma generate && pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.migrate:status: cd packages/database && pnpm exec prisma migrate status
scripts.db:push: cd packages/database && pnpm exec prisma format && pnpm exec prisma generate && pnpm exec prisma db push
